newsitem.title: UK: HSBC 96 dealing profits dip to 515 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: HSBC 96 dealing profits dip to 515 mln stg.

text.p: Dealing profits at HSBC Holdings Plc slipped to 515 million pounds in 1996 from 533 million in 1995.
HSBC's foreign exchange income at 354 million pounds was slightly down against 362 million pounds in 1995, HSBC figures released on Monday showed.
HSBC profits from debt securities was unchanged at 61 million pounds while profits from interest rate derivatives increased to 53 million pounds from 44 million in 1995.
Profits from equities and other trading was down at 47 million pounds from 66 million in 1995, the figures showed.

In a statement accompanying full-company results, the bank said HSBC Midland, which comprises the HSBC Group's treasury operations in London, New York and Tokyo saw its dealing profits increase by 23 million pounds to 160 million pounds.
The bank said this was principally due to higher profits from interest rate derivatives and securities trading.
HSBC Holdings on Monday announced pre-tax profits for 1996 of 4.52 billion pounds ($7.3 billion), up 23 percent from 1995.
